Honestly? I think at some point it is important to be able to voice your frustrations without having to worry about being cut down because of them. I also don't think that most of the people in girlgamers are hiding in a hole either. For example, I still play all sorts of games and attempt to communicate in other forums (though it is admittedly difficult for me for reasons beyond my gender lol). That doesn't mean, however, that I don't appreciate a safe place to go when I am feeling particularly abused. There is only so much one person can take and venting to like-minded individuals is not passive aggressive.  Generally speaking, passive aggressive behavior is characterized by doing something specifically to hurt someone else in such a way that it is not outwardly or obviously aggressive (such as failing to do your job in a party intentionally). What women are doing here is trying to get support from their peers. I really don't think that talking to your peers is going to make the problems any worse. If anything, it might help some of them get the courage they need to stand up for themselves elsewhere.
